name: Meridian Nomad Atlas Open Datasets Manifest

datasets.name: Natural Earth 110m Admin-0 Countries
indicators: Projected using Tom Patterson’s Natural Earth projection
datasets.role: Powers the accurate interactive SVG world map with real country borders, click-to-filter countries, and zero map-tile API costs.

datasets.name: World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI) & ICP PPP
indicators: PA.NUS.PRVT.PP & PA.NUS.FCRF — Household consumption PPP price level ratio
IT.NET.BBND.P2 & IT.NET.USER.ZS — Broadband subscriptions & internet adoption
datasets.role: Powers monthly cost-of-living estimates, 5-year savings projections, inflation stress-testing, air quality, and health context.
datasets.citation: The World Bank: World Development Indicators & ICP (CC BY 4.0).

datasets.name: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI)
indicators: GOV_WGI_PV.SC — Political Stability & Absence of Violence (0–100)
datasets.role: Provides objective, reproducible safety and institutional stability scores without proprietary crowdsourced crime indexes.
datasets.citation: The World Bank: Worldwide Governance Indicators (CC BY 4.0).

datasets.name: NASA POWER Global Climatology
indicators: T2M — 30-year monthly mean temperature at 2 meters (°C)
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN — Surface solar irradiance (daily sunshine proxy)
datasets.role: Powers real 12-month weather curves, comfort scoring, and year-round multi-city itinerary weather planning for every coordinate.
datasets.citation: NASA Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) Project (Public Domain).

datasets.name: GeoNames Geographical Gazetteer (cities15000)
indicators: Elevation (meters), population, ISO-3166 country codes, canonical city slugs
datasets.role: Supplies exact map coordinates, city-size cost adjustments, and deterministic programmatic SEO city URLs.

datasets.name: Measurement Lab (M-Lab) Network Diagnostic Tool (NDT)
datasets.role: Drives remote-work internet speed ratings and video-call smoothness verdicts across cities.
datasets.citation: Measurement Lab (M-Lab) NDT Open Data (CC0 1.0 Public Domain).

datasets.name: IANA Time Zone Database (tzdb)
indicators: Canonical IANA time zone IDs (e.g., Europe/Lisbon, Asia/Tokyo)
Standard and Daylight Saving Time UTC offsets
datasets.role: Powers the 24-hour Team Time-Zone Overlap Checker and live call window grades.
